name: Mike Coxlong
source: Mike is a part-time DJ at Blazer club. He seems to be an easy-going guy, and his laid-back attitude and good looks make him pretty popular with people. He seems to have a good relationship with Jeremy and Ivy. He has a girlfriend, and they live together.
